name: @stepstitch/tracker
description: StepStitch — issue-to-repro infrastructure (not session replay): turns a user-reported problem into scrubbed diagnostics, a replayability score, and a copyable Playwright reproduction, without capturing screens, input values, or page text. Zero runtime dependencies.

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && tsc -p tsconfig.cjs.json && node scripts/finalize-dist.mjs
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run build && npm run type-check && npm test
scripts.release: npm run build && npm run stamp && npm run sbom
